***[[Al-Fashir massacre]]
****Massacres occur in [[Al-Fashir]], [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], as [[Rapid Support Forces]] overwhelm the city and kill civilians for several days, targeting [[Zaghawa people]].  [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-un-condemns-atrocities-in-el-fasher/a-74555528 (DW)]
*[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
**Following peace talks in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]], the governments of [[Afghanistan]] and [[Pakistan]] agree to an extended [[ceasefire]], while Pakistan continues to allege that Afghanistan is sheltering militant groups like the [[Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan|Tehreek-e-Taliban]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-and-afghanistan-agree-to-extend-ceasefire/a-74564295 (DW)]
*[[Israeli–Lebanese conflict]]
**[[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|troops]] enter the southern [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] city of [[Blida, Lebanon|Blida]] and storm the [[Town hall|municipal hall]], killing an employee while sleeping. In response, [[President of Lebanon|Lebanese president]] [[Joseph Aoun]] orders the [[Lebanese Armed Forces|military]] to confront any Israeli incursions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/one-man-killed-israeli-incursion-into-south-lebanon-lebanese-state-media-says-2025-10-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Sagrada Família]] church in [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]], becomes [[List of tallest church buildings|the world's tallest church]] at {{cvt|162.91|meters|feet|abbr=on}} after a part of its central tower was added during construction, surpassing the previously-tallest [[Ulm Minster]] in [[Ulm]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. '''International relations'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] meets [[Paramount leader|Chinese leader]] [[Xi Jinping]] in [[Busan]], [[South Korea]], on the sidelines of the [[APEC South Korea 2025|APEC summit]] in [[Gyeongju]], agreeing to lower [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration|tariffs on China]] in return for lower [[rare earth metals|rare earth]] trade curbs. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/trump-xi-meeting-apec-summit-live-5429356 (CNA)]
